## Abstract

smore-004 was similar to smore-002. The launch went well, but after reaching about 6500 meters altitude immediately started to descend and landed somewhere near the Ohio-West Virginia border, not making it out of Ohio. Assumed to be either a balloon or rigging failure. The balloon went north, crossing the Arctic Circle but because trapped in the middle of a storm and likely went down due to icing near Baffin Island, Canada.
